title: Wick-Wightman-Wigner superselection as an F9 (No Unstatused Residual) + F4 (Local-Global Obstruction) co-instantiation: an honest structural classification, not a derivation
scientific_domain: Foundational quantum field theory / algebraic quantum mechanics (superselection sectors)

card.one_sentence_claim: SBT recognizes the Wick-Wightman-Wigner superselection architecture (each admissible pure state in exactly one charge sector; no cross-sector coherence) as a co-instantiation of two Lean-certified layer-agnostic normal forms - F9 (No Unstatused Residual / single-valued typed-status classifier) for 'exactly one sector per state' and F4 (Local-Global Obstruction, compatible-non-global status) for 'locally consistent phases that fail to glue into a coherent cross-sector superposition' - but the physics (which observables superselect, that they commute with all observables, univalence/spin-statistics) is imported by declaration, so this is a structural relabeling, not a derivation.
card.target_known_fact: Wick-Wightman-Wigner (1952) superselection rules: physically admissible pure states lie in a single joint eigenspace of the superselection observables (electric charge Q, baryon number B, lepton number L, univalence (-1)^{2J}); coherent superpositions across distinct charge sectors are excluded from the physical state space, reducing to sector-mixtures, because the relative cross-sector phase is unobservable.

theory_basis.component: F9 No Unstatused Residual (thm:F9): given a residual type R, a formed stability package, and a declared typed-status classifier st_P:R->S that the package discipline makes single-valued, every residual receives exactly one typed status and no orphan/unstatused residual exists. Lean: Stability.NoUnstatusedResidual.no_unstatused_residual (statTheorem, faithful, in the 46 direct-theorem set).
theory_basis.paper: Tsiokos_2026_Six_Birds_Foundations_IV_A_Catalog_of_Layer_Agnostic_Structural_Laws.tex (thm:F9 line 2080, layer-inst:F9 line 2140; WWW prose lines 2179-2190)
theory_basis.role: Supplies the 'exactly one sector per admissible pure state' skeleton: physical sector = F9 typed status; the WWW exclusion of orphan/multi-sector states = the single-value + coverage discipline. VERIFIED: theorem statement is content-free ('single-valued classifier + residual coverage => unique typed status'); WWW already appears verbatim as one of FIVE F9 layer instantiations alongside GHS chemical-hazard labels, Wright-Felleisen type soundness, the ribosomal genetic code, and Gale-Shapley matching.

theory_basis.component: F4 Local-Global Obstruction Normal Form (thm:F4): given local-family data F, a compatibility predicate Comp, and a restriction map R:G->F with Comp(R(g)) always, every a in F gets exactly one of four mutually exclusive statuses {overlap-inconsistent, compatible-non-global, globally-ambiguous, globally-exact}. Lean: Transport.LocalGlobalObstruction.local_global_obstruction_normal_form (statTheorem, faithful).
theory_basis.role: Supplies the 'why no coherent cross-sector superposition' skeleton: a would-be cross-sector pure state = locally compatible phase data not in the image of the restriction (compatible-non-global). VERIFIED CORRECTION: WWW superselection is NOT among the F4 layer instantiations in the corpus (which are Cech H^1 sheaf gluing, G/H topological defects, schema mapping, genome assembly, pose-graph SLAM). The F4 leg of this co-instantiation is the card's OWN PROPOSED instantiation, not existing certified prose. VERIFIED: F4 contains a built-in GloballyExact status (line 2604, 2638-2641) which is exactly the no-superselection (coherence-glues-to-global) world.

theory_basis.role: Names the conserved-sector-label primitive that the charge superselection labels (Q,B,L) are mapped onto; provides SBT's vocabulary for 'sectors' but no Hilbert-space exclusion mechanism.

auxiliary_assumptions: The set of superselection charges and the commutant structure (they commute with every physical observable) is supplied as the declared family, not derived within SBT.
Admissible pure states are sector-pure - this is the WWW content being 'recovered', assumed as the coverage/single-value input to F9 (Dictionary lemma A).

Univalence/(-1)^{2J} (spin-statistics) is imported as a given superselection observable; SBT has no exchange-statistics or spin-statistics machinery (confirmed by candidates.json R024 honest negative).

The Lean certification covers only the layer-agnostic bookkeeping theorems (thm:F9, thm:F4); the quantum/superselection instantiation is prose (F9) or unwritten (F4), not mechanized.
card.minimum_viable_result: A written F9+F4 co-instantiation of WWW superselection presented strictly as a derivability-class-C structural classification: state thm:F9 and thm:F4 (both Lean-certified, faithful, for the ABSTRACT statement only), supply the explicit physics-to-structure dictionary (sector = typed status; cross-sector superposition = compatible-non-global), label the F4 leg as a NEW proposed instantiation absent from the corpus, and honestly fence that (i) sector-purity of admissible states and (ii) phase-unobservability are imported declarations, with no Hilbert-space exclusion, no spin-statistics, and no derivation of the superselecting charge set.
card.stronger_result: A finite SBT-internal demonstration that a charge-BLOCK dephasing closure Delta(rho)=sum_b Pi_b rho Pi_b (multidimensional sector projectors) has fixed points = exactly the sector-block-diagonal states. NOTE/CORRECTION: this is NOT covered by the certified dephase_idem / dephase_fixed_iff_exists_diagonal, which prove fixed points are FULLY diagonal (rho=diag(v)), killing intra-sector coherence too (Quantum paper thm:dephase line 406). The block-dephasing generalization needs SEPARATE Lean work. Even then it still imports the charge basis (pointer-basis disclaimed) and the charge set.
card.fallback_result: Present R022 strictly as a classification entry - 'WWW superselection is co-statused by F9 (single-valuedness) and F4 (compatible-non-global)', with the F9 leg already in the corpus prose and the F4 leg flagged as a proposed (uncertified-for-this-instance) mapping, plus an explicit nonclaim block. Honest, low-cost, crosses no disclaimer.
card.baseline_comparison: Strictly a RECOVERY/RELABELING, not an improvement over the standard account, and weaker than it in predictive content. The standard WWW/DHR account derives WHICH charges superselect (from the observable algebra's commutant/representation theory) and produces the Hilbert-space sector decomposition. SBT does neither: no Hilbert space, no commutant, no Born rule, no spin-statistics. What SBT genuinely adds is unification of bookkeeping FORM: 'one sector per state' (F9) and 'no coherent gluing' (F4) under the same two layer-agnostic normal forms it uses for Cech H^1, G/H defects, schema mapping, genome assembly, and SLAM - a real organizational/compression insight about the SHAPE of the rule, but every load-bearing physical fact is imported by declaration.
card.why_scientists_care: Superselection is one of the cleanest 'why-is-this-forbidden' rules in physics, sitting at the boundary of several SBT disclaimers (pointer-basis selection, single-outcome collapse, the Born rule). Showing 'one sector per state' and 'no cross-sector coherence' as two faces of the same layer-agnostic normal form that also governs sheaf-gluing failure and topological defects is conceptually attractive. It is a high-leverage test of whether the F-catalog's structural unification is illuminating or merely terminological - and the honest answer (illuminating in form, vacuous in physical content) is itself a useful calibration of the layer-agnostic program.

card.honest_status_note: Derivability-class-C structural classification, NOT a derivation. The two leaned-on theorems (thm:F9, thm:F4) are real, elementary, Lean-certified (faithful) but content-free bookkeeping. Every physically load-bearing piece is imported by declaration: which observables superselect, that they commute with all observables (so phase is unobservable), sector-purity of admissible pure states, and univalence/spin-statistics (no SBT machinery). The Lean certification covers only the abstract theorems; the F9 superselection instantiation is prose and the F4 instantiation is NOT YET in the corpus at all. SBT cannot produce a Hilbert space, cannot exclude superpositions (no Born rule, no stochastic/quantum lens in certified core), and disclaims pointer-basis/lens selection. Verdict: honest, low-cost, conceptually tidy relabeling that recovers the statement and reorganizes the logical form of WWW; no better than - and in physical content strictly worse than - the standard account. No disclaimers crossed as long as the note refuses to claim derivation of the charge set, the exclusion mechanism, or spin-statistics.

opposite_world_test.explanation: VERIFIED against the F4 statement (lines 2604, 2638-2641): F4 has a built-in GloballyExact status (Comp(a), a in R(G), |R^{-1}(a)|=1) which is exactly the world where a would-be cross-sector superposition DOES glue into a global pure state (no superselection). A coherent-superposition universe is the GloballyExact branch; the WWW universe is the CompatibleNonGlobal branch. Which branch obtains is fixed entirely by the hand-declared restriction-map image (i.e. by importing phase-(un)observability), not by any SBT mechanism. Symmetrically, F9 is satisfied by any single-valued classifier including a trivial one-sector (no-superselection) world. The framework has a named slot for both outcomes, so the match carries no predictive content.
